metaTitle: Custom Set in Sleeve Jerseys | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set in sleeve jerseys in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for teams and events. Fast turnaround.
introHtml: Set in sleeve jerseys offer a structured, professional look that raglan or drop-shoulder styles can't match. The sewn-in shoulder seam creates a clean line that holds up to screen printing and embroidery, making them a favorite for corporate sports teams and uniform programs. Whether you need youth sizes from Gildan Performance or adult cuts for your company softball league, this sleeve style delivers consistent branding and a polished appearance.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve jerseys with screen printed logos, ideal for team uniforms and corporate events
